blocks.text: Key Strata Checks When Buying an Abbotsford Townhome

parts.t: When comparing Abbotsford townhomes, look closely at four details in the strata package: (1) garage and driveway apron rules (many three-storey complexes have tandem garages and prohibit overhang parking on short aprons); (2) roof, siding, window, and deck membrane ages in the Depreciation Report, particularly on 1990s wood-frame complexes in Clearbrook and Central Abbotsford; (3) pet restrictions (number of dogs/cats and any shoulder-height or weight rules); and (4) age restrictions, as Central Abbotsford and Clearbrook include both unrestricted family complexes and 55+ rancher townhomes.

blocks.text: 7 Common Questions About Abbotsford Townhomes for Sale

parts.t: How does this page differ from the Abbotsford Townhomes Under $1.2M page?

This page shows every active townhome in Abbotsford regardless of price—including executive $1.2M+ hillside view townhomes on Eagle Mountain and Ledgeview—whereas the Under $1.2M page filters strictly below $1,200,000.
Where are newer family townhomes located in Abbotsford?

Newer three- and four-bedroom family townhomes are concentrated in Westerleigh (near Highstreet in Abbotsford West), along Whatcom Road, Old Clayburn Road, McKee, and Eagle Mountain (Abbotsford East), and in the UDistrict near UFV (Central Abbotsford).
Where can I find one-level rancher townhomes in Abbotsford?

Single-level rancher and master-on-main townhomes are primarily located in Clearbrook, Central Abbotsford (near Mill Lake and Gladwin Road), and McMillan/Old Clayburn in East Abbotsford, available in both 55+ and all-ages complexes.
What do monthly strata fees cover in an Abbotsford townhome?

In a standard strata townhome, monthly fees cover building insurance, exterior roof and siding upkeep, common landscaping, snow clearing on private strata lanes, garbage/recycling pickup, management, and Contingency Reserve Fund contributions.
Can I install an EV charger in my Abbotsford townhome garage?

Most townhome garages have an individual electrical sub-panel or circuit, and recent BC Strata Property Act updates make it easier for owners to request strata council permission for Level 2 EV charging installations, with many newer complexes built EV-ready.
Are rentals allowed in Abbotsford townhome complexes?
Yes—under BC's Strata Property Act, strata corporations cannot enforce general long-term rental bans in non-age-restricted townhome complexes, though short-term vacation rentals remain restricted.
